title: Multi-Client Surplus Withdrawal Drains Other Clients' Yield
rootCause: _withdrawFrom() redeems shares from a communal pool but totalBalanceOf() computes each client's balance as (totalVaultValue * principal) / totalDeposited. Burning shared shares for one client's surplus proportionally reduces every other client's totalBalanceOf.
impact: Direct loss of accrued yield for all other clients when surplus is extracted for any single client. Two clients each deposit 1000, vault generates 200 yield (100 each). Extracting A's 100 surplus burns shared shares, reducing vault value from 2200 to 2100. B's surplus drops from 100 to 50 — B lost 50% of their yield.
recommendation: Track vault shares per-client instead of using proportional-principal accounting. Each client's share count should be tracked independently via clientShares[token][account].
